scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.production:status: powershell -Command "try { (Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:5000/health | ConvertTo-Json -Compress); (Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:5000/ready | ConvertTo-Json -Compress); (Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3000 -UseBasicParsing).StatusCode } catch { Write-Host 'One or both services are not responding.' }"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=apps/api && npm install --workspace=apps/web && npm install --workspace=apps/mobile
